annotations.title: Post a document to the ledger

description: Books a draft document: base lines, VAT lines from the tax configuration, and the customer or supplier counterpart, numbered and posted. A posted entry is never edited; a mistake is undone by cancel_document, which puts the document back to draft only where its country allows it and nothing has left, and issues a credit note otherwise. The database decides whether you may, from the company's agent_posting (get_company) and this session's choice: in review, the default, only once a person has approved this draft as it stands (ekwo doc approve, or the web application) — refused with approval_required otherwise, and again if the draft changed after the approval; in autopilot, directly, within your rights; autopilot_forbidden where the session asked for autopilot and the company allows review only. Either way the posting is recorded on the audit trail as an agent's, with the mode and the session. dry_run: true is always allowed and is what to show the user before they approve. This session follows each company's agent_posting. It refuses a locked period, a tax that is not in force, and a header total that disagrees with the lines. Next: get_document shows the entry it wrote, and record_payment books the money when it moves.

dry_run.description: True: the database posts for real and takes it back, and the entry it would have written is returned. Nothing is written; a refusal is the one posting would give.
